paragraph: Neither Kausalya's tears nor Lakshmana's anger swayed the noble son of Dasaratha, from his resolve, as he said, "I do not have the strength to defy my father. In the days of yore, Rishi Kandu accrued the sin of slaying a cow in discharging his filial duty. The sons of Sagara destroyed many lives in fulfilling their father's wishes. Parasurama executing the orders of his father Jamadagni axed his mother to death. Many a man of might and honor had obeyed his sire and so will I. Am I establishing a new code of honour that had not existed earlier?"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Despite emotional appeals from his mother and brother, Rama remains resolute in fulfilling his father's command to go into exile. He invokes historical examples of extreme filial obedience to justify his choice.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama demonstrates steadfast commitment to dharma (duty), even in the face of emotional turmoil from loved ones. He uses past examples of sacrificial obedience to reinforce his decision, reflecting the cultural and moral weight of filial piety.
Outcome/Resolution: In this specific paragraph, the immediate outcome is that Rama's resolve remains unshaken. Neither Kausalya's tears nor Lakshmana's anger succeed in swaying him from his commitment to his father's command. His decision to proceed with the exile is cemented by his appeal to historical precedents of filial obedience.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Dharma (Duty - Rama’s unwavering adherence to his father’s command)
Tyaga (Sacrifice - Sacrificing his own desires and comfort for righteousness)
Vairagya (Detachment - Rama’s calm detachment from emotional attachments)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rama exemplifies 'Dharma' and 'Tyaga' by prioritizing duty over personal attachments. His demeanor reflects 'Vairagya' as he stays emotionally detached to uphold righteousness and tradition.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Psychologically, Rama displays high emotional control and disciplined stress management despite strong emotional appeals. The tension illustrates deep relationship challenges rooted in conflicting familial expectations and personal values.
